newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw bourse seen extending gains on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw bourse seen extending gains on Tuesday.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to rise for the fourth consecutive session on Tuesday on bargain-hunting after last week's falls.
Analysts said, however, the growth was likely to be limited and said even a flat session was possible, as the market remained in its broad 2.5-month horizontal trend.
They said Novita which unexpectedly jumped nine percent on Monday was likely to fall in profit-taking.
